consequence.statement: The new GRPCRoute CRD must be installed and GRPCRoute resources migrated from v1alpha2 to v1.
consequence.remediation: Install the new GRPCRoute CRD and migrate resources from v1alpha2 to v1.

original.statement: Gateway API GRPCRoute moved from v1alpha2 to v1; the new GRPCRoute CRD must be installed and resources migrated from v1alpha2 to v1.

decision.reason: [ev-ee4d25413bf4] is in the 1.16 Upgrade Notes. It tells operators to install the new GRPCRoute CRD and migrate their resources from v1alpha2 to v1, which is a required operator step and fits migration-required (action class). The proposed statement only repeats that instruction. Unlike P1, it does not add the unsupported claim that v1alpha2 stops being served.
